prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE original native pixel-art terrain tile for Theandril, a serious weathered dark-fantasy strategy map. RAINFOREST: irregular interlocking tropical canopy with two very broad fan-leaf masses and several lower moss-green crowns, deep dark green understory glimpsed between, small dark opening. Distinct from temperate forest by broad layered leaves, subdued jade not saturated green. Exact flat overhead pointy-top HEXAGON with top and bottom vertices; width:height 7:8, no sides, thickness, bevel, outline, shadow or isometric platform. Full opaque terrain inside the hex; genuinely transparent PNG everywhere outside, not a checkerboard. Complete hex inside generous transparent margins. Intentional coarse 64x64 logical pixel detail, hard square pixel clusters, only 8–12 subdued material colors, large readable 3–8 pixel shapes; consistent diffuse upper-left light. Quiet low-contrast outer fifth blends with adjoining variants. No roads, rivers, usable resource deposits, buildings, characters, borders, text, labels or UI. No tiny scattered noise, no smooth painting or blur, no glowing or glossy mobile-game colors. Original fantasy artwork, not copied designs.
